'''Marina Inoue''' (Japanese: '''井上麻里奈''' ''Inoue Marina'') is a Japanese voice actress for {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Inoue was born on January 20, 1985, in {{wp|Tokyo}}, {{wp|Japan}}, and became a voice actress as an adult. She joined the {{pkmn|animated series}} during {{aniseries|XY}}, where she voiced {{an|Aria}}. Later, Inoue voiced [[Malva]] in [[Pokémon Generations]] and [[Sonia]] in {{aniseries|JN}}. Inoue is currently affiliated with {{wp|Aoni Production}}.
